description: Which carried names and third-person pronouns in the 1,952 scored résumés refer to the résumé's owner. Two independent labelling passes (Claude subagents, 2026-10-21) over every occurrence of the detected given name and every he/him/his/himself/she/her/hers/herself; they agreed on 333 of 333 names and 270 of 273 pronouns. A third reading by the same model settled the three pronoun disagreements and changed one name that both passes had given to the owner (a co-author in a publication list) to another person. No person checked the labels before the runs; data/owner_marker_handcheck.json holds a later blind check of 40 of them by one of the authors. (Description corrected twice on 2026-10-26; the labels are unchanged from the files the owner-only runs used, sha256 2f1e31c3f475224264c5f7ef30afa18a5a97f610fed10ecd8791a6fabc9072e2 and 4b03d5d66ea067032691609a57a7dea4fe77a39c669520cbdcca8a91a11dd303.) owner_spans locate each occurrence of the owner's name (character offsets into the corpus text, with the sha256 of the text there) and the template that replaces it in each form: {given}, {surname}, {full} (given and surname), {mr} (Mr or Ms).
